source_name: GZS – Preprečevanje pranja denarja (Chamber of Commerce AML practitioner hub)
why_relevant: Industry-side digest of AML obligations, seminars and supervisor Q&A. Useful for spotting where obliged entities perceive ambiguity and which deadlines are causing friction — a demand-side signal for compliance services.

entity_name: Uradni list RS English-language and EU-facing act pages
source_name: Uradni list RS English-language and EU-facing act pages (en secondary channel)
why_relevant: English coverage of Slovenian primary banking legislation is thin and non-authoritative - the gazette publishes in Slovene. Tracked here only to record that the English route exists mainly through supervisor translations (Banka Slovenije en pages) and EU-level transposition notices, not through the gazette itself. Important for setting expectations on en-language collection.

source_name: Wikipedia – Seznam bank v Sloveniji / List of banks in Slovenia
why_relevant: Unofficial but convenient consolidated list of SI banks with historical merger/rebrand lineage (useful for name normalisation across decades of register snapshots). Must never be used as the authoritative population — only as an alias/lineage aid.

source_name: Apps Run The World - NLB d.d. customer software purchase profile
why_relevant: Commercial IT-buyer database profiling NLB's software stack and digital-transformation purchases. Useful as a cross-check on which vendors claim NLB, though it is a paid aggregator and its entries must be corroborated against vendor primary sources.

source_name: Društvo novinarjev Slovenije — investigative-journalism tag feed
why_relevant: Journalists' association tag page that surfaces which sl outlets and reporters are doing investigative finance work — a pointer for expanding the media actor map and identifying beat reporters covering Banka Slovenije.

source_name: EU Public Procurement portal (op.europa.eu) — procurement detail records
why_relevant: Publications Office front-end presenting individual procurement records (including Slovenian banking-services procurements) in a stable, citable form; complements TED notices with consolidated per-procedure views useful for evidencing award histories.

Fourth Big Four office in SI; expected to publish local regulatory and financial-services alerts. Included as a to-verify actor: no SI-specific banking/payments alert stream was surfaced by search in this run.

source_name: Insurer complaint-procedure pages (pritožbeni postopki) – Generali, GRAWE, Wiz, Merkur
why_relevant: Mandatory published complaint routes on insurer sites, naming the internal body, AZN and the SZZ ADR bodies. Same diff logic as bank T&Cs; also relevant for insurtech/bancassurance distribution.

Third-party aggregator of Slovenian and regional tender notices with its own categorisation and alerting. Useful as a redundancy/cross-check layer against enarocanje.si and to catch notices whose CPV coding is wrong, but not authoritative and likely subscription-gated for detail.

Smaller Ljubljana firm explicitly serving financial institutions; representative of the long tail of SI boutiques whose occasional sl-language client notes can surface practical compliance points the large firms skip.
Example of the sl regional-portal layer that republishes STA/ZPS material openly and without a paywall — a practical free proxy for wire content otherwise gated at sta.si.

Private e-procurement/e-sourcing platform used by Slovenian buyers alongside the state system. Some public and state-owned buyers run their sourcing here, so its public notice listing can surface procedures (and vendor references) not obvious on the state portal; also a competitor/partner signal in the procurement-tech layer.
Insurance association publishes presentations on AZN supervision of insurance agents and brokers (including bank channels), giving practitioner-level detail on how supervision is actually conducted.

source_name: UniCredit Banka Slovenija — customer notices on payment operations
why_relevant: Payment-cut-off and payment-scheme notices are where SEPA/instant-payments regulatory deadlines become concretely observable at the product level. UniCredit SI was not in the original cell list but is a systemic private bank in the same demand-side category.

Free site exposing Slovenian statutes at individual-article granularity with NPB (neuradno prečiščeno besedilo) version labels - useful when the question is 'what exactly changed in article X of the payments act'. Unofficial consolidations, so treat as a navigation aid only.
